newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northland Cranberries buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northland Cranberries buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Monday she reiterated her buy rating on Northland Cranberries Inc, which is accelerating the national roll-out of its juice line due to good results in existing markets.

-- "(Information Resources) data from the markets where Northland has had a presence for at least 40 weeks continue to look excellent in the most recently available period ended December 29, 1996," Wittenburg wrote in a report. "Moreover, the IRI data also shows Northland is quickly growing its penetration of store shelves, and also selling more product in its existing markets."
-- The analyst said her target price for the stock remains $30 a share.
-- Northland Cranberries shares were unchanged at 17-1/4.
